arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
APP=/srv/lowcost-europa
ACCT=le001_1789265592
OLD=8b8bdaeaeb49f01def64b127f1b0c1459d5cf24e
TARGET=388860c6a167686a378b89f4282304bce89c25de
ENVFILE=/etc/lowcost-europa/lowcost-europa.env
ENVBACKUP=/etc/lowcost-europa/.lowcost-recovery-20261030-$$
changed_code=0
changed_env=0
rollback() {
 code=$?
 trap - ERR
 echo "STAGING_DEPLOY_FAILURE_EXIT=$code"
 if test "$changed_env" = 1 && sudo -n test -f "$ENVBACKUP"; then
   sudo -n cp -a "$ENVBACKUP" "$ENVFILE" && echo ROLLBACK_ENV=RESTORED || echo ROLLBACK_ENV=FAILED
 fi
 if test "$changed_code" = 1; then
   sudo -n -u "$ACCT" git -C "$APP" checkout --detach "$OLD" && echo ROLLBACK_CODE=RESTORED || echo ROLLBACK_CODE=FAILED
 fi
 sudo -n systemctl restart lowcost-europa.service && echo ROLLBACK_SERVICE=RESTARTED || echo ROLLBACK_SERVICE=FAILED
 sudo -n rm -f "$ENVBACKUP" || true
 exit "$code"
}
trap rollback ERR
echo STAGING_DEPLOY=START
test "$(sudo -n -u "$ACCT" git -C "$APP" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$OLD"
test -z "$(sudo -n -u "$ACCT" git -C "$APP" status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=normal)"
echo LIVE_BASE=EXACT_CLEAN
sudo -n test -f "$ENVFILE"
test "$(sudo -n grep -Ec '^DJANGO_SECURE_HSTS_SECONDS=' "$ENVFILE")" = 1
sudo -n grep -q '^DJANGO_SECURE_HSTS_SECONDS=0$' "$ENVFILE"
echo HSTS_OLD_VALUE=ZERO_CONFIRMED
for svc in lowcost-europa-backup.service lowcost-europa-offsite-backup.service lowcost-europa-offsite-backup-health.service; do
 test "$(systemctl show -P Result "$svc")" = success
 test "$(systemctl show -P ExecMainStatus "$svc")" = 0
 stamp="$(systemctl show -P ExecMainExitTimestamp "$svc")"
 case "$stamp" in *"$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)"*) ;; *) echo "BACKUP_NOT_TODAY=$svc"; exit 19 ;; esac
 echo "BACKUP=$svc;PASS"
done
for svc in lowcost-europa.service nginx.service postgresql.service; do
 systemctl is-active --quiet "$svc"
 echo "SERVICE_BEFORE=$svc;ACTIVE"
done
echo FETCH_TARGET=START
sudo -n -u "$ACCT" git -C "$APP" fetch --no-tags origin main >/dev/null
test "$(sudo -n -u "$ACCT" git -C "$APP" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$TARGET"
echo FETCH_TARGET=EXACT_MAIN
sudo -n cp -a "$ENVFILE" "$ENVBACKUP"
sudo -n -u "$ACCT" git -C "$APP" checkout --detach "$TARGET" >/dev/null
changed_code=1
sudo -n sed -i -e 's/^DJANGO_SECURE_HSTS_SECONDS=0$/DJANGO_SECURE_HSTS_SECONDS=3600/' "$ENVFILE"
changed_env=1
sudo -n grep -q '^DJANGO_SECURE_HSTS_SECONDS=3600$' "$ENVFILE"
echo SOURCE_AND_ENV=UPDATED
app_manage() {
 sudo -n bash -c '
 set -a
 . /etc/lowcost-europa/lowcost-europa.env
 set +a
 export DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE=config.settings.production
 cd /srv/lowcost-europa
 runuser -u le001_1789265592 -- .venv/bin/python manage.py "$@"
 ' bash "$@"
}
app_manage check >/dev/null 2>&1
echo DJANGO_CHECK=PASS
app_manage check --deploy >/dev/null 2>&1
echo DJANGO_DEPLOY_CHECK=PASS
app_manage makemigrations --check --dry-run >/dev/null 2>&1
echo MIGRATION_DRIFT=NONE
app_manage shell -c '
from django.conf import settings
assert not settings.DEBUG
assert not settings.PUBLIC_INDEXING_ENABLED
assert settings.SECURE_HSTS_SECONDS == 3600
assert not settings.SECURE_HSTS_PRELOAD
assert not settings.SECURE_HSTS_INCLUDE_SUBDOMAINS
print("SETTINGS_PRIVATE_STAGING=PASS")
' | grep -F 'SETTINGS_PRIVATE_STAGING=PASS'
sudo -n systemctl restart lowcost-europa.service
systemctl is-active --quiet lowcost-europa.service
echo APP_RESTART=PASS
BASE=https://lowcost-europa.duckdns.org
headers="$(curl -fsS --max-time 22 -D - -o /dev/null "$BASE/" | tr -d '\r')"
printf '%s\n' "$headers" | grep -iq '^strict-transport-security: max-age=3600'
printf '%s\n' "$headers" | grep -iq '^x-robots-tag:.*noindex'
echo HSTS_AND_NOINDEX=PASS
curl -fsS --max-time 20 "$BASE/robots.txt" | grep -Fq 'Disallow: /'
echo ROBOTS_TXT=PASS
for p in / /health/live/ /health/ready/ /products/cavitacao-rf-vacuum-corpo/ /products/hydrodermoabrasao-aqua-facial-multifuncoes/ /products/pressoterapia-vacuum-drenagem/ /products/hifu/ /products/diodo-laser-remocao-tatuagens-pigmentacao/; do
 status="$(curl -sS --max-time 20 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "$BASE$p")"
 test "$status" = 200
 echo "PAGE=$p;STATUS=$status"
done
test "$(curl -sS --max-time 20 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "$BASE/painel/")" = 302
echo OWNER_PANEL_PRIVATE=PASS
test "$(sudo -n -u "$ACCT" git -C "$APP" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$TARGET"
test -z "$(sudo -n -u "$ACCT" git -C "$APP" status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=normal)"
echo LIVE_FINAL_SHA="$TARGET"
echo LIVE_WORKTREE=CLEAN
trap - ERR
sudo -n rm -f "$ENVBACKUP"
echo ENV_ROLLBACK_FILE=REMOVED
echo STAGING_DEPLOY=PASS
